items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, we only have the Eurozone Sentix investor confidence index which is expected at 2.1 vs 2.7 prior. The data won't change anything for the ECB, so the market reaction will be muted.  The focus remains mainly on US-Iran developments and the fallout from the US midterm elections.
items.summaryZh: 欧洲会议在欧洲会议上，我们只有欧元区Sentix投资者信心指数，该指数预计为2.1 ，而之前为2.7。数据不会改变欧洲央行的任何事情，因此市场反应将被淡化。焦点仍然主要集中在美伊事态发展和美国中期选举的影响上。

items.title: US CPI preview: Wall Street sees cooler inflation but the Fed may not blink
items.summary: Perhaps one of the more intriguing prospects heading into the US CPI report today is what if inflation cools and the Fed simply decides to shrug it off? Well, that may very well happen.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 也许今天进入美国CPI报告的更有趣的前景之一是，如果通货膨胀降温，美联储只是决定摆脱它呢？嗯，这很可能发生。
